title: Campaign friction log entry (one JSON object per line)
description: Post-G3a handoff §3: every refusal the campaign agent meets, classified. useful: stopped a real error. false: a sound claim was refused. ergonomic: the right refusal with an unhelpful message. Makes KILL-CRITERIA A5 prospective.

task.description: The cost-log task this refusal belongs to.

builder_fix.description: The builder commit that fixed a false or ergonomic refusal.
